evidence.quote: Brightline would separately pay up to $3.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses; any amount not awarded would go to the class.
We can offer a $32 million class fund plus up to $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses, with any unawarded fees added to the class fund.
We can reduce our request to a $35 million class fund, with your proposed $3 million fee cap and the other protections unchanged.

summary: Plaintiff first raised attorneys’ fees in Round 1 while class relief was still being negotiated. Fee terms were discussed before the final $34 million class fund was agreed, and the transcript links unawarded fees to increased class recovery. There is no clear evidence that class counsel pursued its own fee interest over the class, that defense exploited fee interests, that a reverse auction occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
